translationRepairs: At Fuxian Zhuge Zhan hesitated; Huang Chong urged him repeatedly to seize the passes before Deng Ai reached the plain.
At Fu County, Zhuge Zhan hesitated; Huang Chong urged him repeatedly to seize the passes before Deng Ai reached the plain.
Idiomatic fuses place-name 涪縣 (Fu County) into 'Fuxian' as if part of Zhuge Zhan's name.

Zhang did not listen; in the end he dispatched an envoy to welcome the lord [first sovereign]; he transferred Quan out to be chief of Guanghan; when the First Sovereign seized Yi Province by surprise, generals and commanders fanned out into commanderies and counties.

Zhang did not listen; in the end he dispatched an envoy to welcome the First Sovereign; he transferred Quan out to be chief of Guanghan; when the First Sovereign seized Yi Province by surprise, generals and commanders fanned out into commanderies and counties.
Source Chinese has 先生 (likely scribal error for 先主); literal already glosses correctly but should say First Sovereign without the awkward bracketed aside.
Liu Zhang refused, sent envoys to welcome Liu Bei anyway, and sidelined Huang Quan as chief of Guanghan. When Liu Bei struck, generals spread through the province.

Liu Zhang refused, sent an envoy to welcome Liu Bei anyway, and transferred Huang Quan out as chief of Guanghan. When Liu Bei seized Yi Province by surprise, generals and commanders spread through the commanderies and counties.
Idiomatic omits surprise seizure of Yi and pluralizes envoy; align with 遣使 and 襲取益州.
〈The Shu ji records Emperor Ming asking him which regime heaven favored among the three rivals.”
〈The Shu ji records that Emperor Ming of Wei asked Huang Quan which place should be considered orthodox while the realm stood like a tripod.
Idiomatic misquotes and leaves a broken quotation; Chinese asks 當以何地為正, not 'which regime heaven favored'.
When Mars stalled in the Heart lodger and Wei’s Emperor Wen died, the rulers of Wu and Shu were untouched—that is the proof.”〉”
When Mars lodged in the Heart and Wei’s Emperor Wen died, the rulers of Wu and Shu were untouched—that is the proof.”〉
Fixes 'lodger' typo for lodge/lodged and removes stray extra closing quote.
He later held titular rank as Yi inspector after submitting to Wei and living south of the Yellow River.
He later held concurrent rank as Inspector of Yi Province and moved to reside south of the Yellow River.
Chinese 徙佔河南 / 領益州刺史 does not say the inspectorship was merely titular after submitting; literal is closer.
Outnumbered and out of contact with Zhuge Liang, Li Hui lied to the rebels that Shu’s supplies were gone and he meant to defect south rather than march north again.”
Outnumbered and out of contact with Zhuge Liang, Li Hui lied to the southern men that the government army’s grain was exhausted and he meant to withdraw and join them rather than march north again.
Idiomatic truncates the false speech, misstates 'defect south', and leaves a stray closing quote; Chinese has a fuller speech about returning to plot with them.
His son Li Yi inherited the title; his cousin Li Qiu, colonel of the right wing of the imperial guard, followed Zhuge Zhan against Deng Ai and died fighting at Mianzhu.
His son Li Yi inherited the title; Li Hui’s elder brother’s son Li Qiu, colonel of the right wing of the Feathered Forest Guard, followed Zhuge Zhan against Deng Ai and died fighting at Mianzhu.
弟子 is brother’s son (nephew), not cousin; 羽林右部督 is Feathered Forest, not generic imperial guard.

In times past the general's late father Marquis Yong—though he incurred resentment yet was enfeoffed; Dou Rong knew the rising [trend] and turned his allegiance to Emperor Guangwu—all flowed their names to later generations; the age sings their beauty.

In times past the general's late father Marquis Yong, though he incurred resentment, was still enfeoffed; Dou Rong recognized the rising tide and turned his allegiance to Emperor Guangwu—both left their names to later ages, and the world still sings their praise.
Literal is broken by dashes and awkward syntax; smooth while preserving sense.

After Yanxi 5 and 7, 十二年卒 is Yanxi 12 (AD 249), not Jianxing 12.

In the twelfth year [of Yanxi] he died; his son Xiu succeeded.
Clarify Yanxi continuity for 十二年.

張松子 means son of Zhang Song, not a name Zhang Songzi.

Chinese continues after the fanqie note without repeating the surname; keep Gou Fu identity but avoid inventing narrative not in this unit's Chinese.
Some urged abandoning the field for Han and Le cities—let Wei through while reinforcements from Fu march up to rescue the passes.”
Some urged firmly defending Han and Le cities—let the enemy enter while reinforcements from Fu march up to rescue the passes.
Chinese does not say 'abandoning the field'; it proposes holding the two cities. Also remove stray closing quote.

After he died, his eldest son Ying was enfeoffed as marquis of Xixiang and his second son Huguo inherited the noble title.
Align closer to 既亡，封長子瑛…次子護雄襲爵 without inventing surname repetition style issues; Huguo is 護雄.
